title: post bridge: Create Once, Post Everywhere
summary: A 15 s launch promo for post bridge, a cross-posting scheduler. Deep navy canvas, lowercase rounded-geometric type with the key word in mint green ('create once.', 'post to every platform.'), a video card orbited by platform icons, a composer card with a 'post everywhere' button, a 2x5 grid of phones filling up with a 00/10 counter, then rapid flat-colour word cards (tiktok. linkedin. all at once.) on the beat, a chat prompt scheduling the post on a week grid, and a white logo end card. Friendly, crisp, very legible.
fit_reason: Clear one-benefit-per-scene SaaS storytelling on navy with a single bright accent; the green/navy split maps easily to SaaSSuite's navy + accent placeholder.

palette.mood: dark navy premium with mint-green highlight and pink-to-purple media cards; flash cards in mint #65cb89 and off-white #f4f7f9
